name: easygee
description: Google Earth Engine, geemap, GeoMaster, GeoAI Encyclopedia, and GEE Growth Diary workflows with bilingual 5,000+ dataset discovery, auth guidance, quota checks, and a persistent high-performance Map Console.

interface.shortDescription: Discover GEE data, plan workflows, check quotas, and build browser maps.
interface.longDescription: EasyGEE packages a Google Earth Engine and geemap workflow layer for agents, plus bundled GeoMaster, GeoAI Encyclopedia, and GEE Growth Diary skill snapshots. Its bilingual discovery engine searches more than 5,000 official and community catalog records by id, theme, or task; ranks provenance and deprecation; recommends role-based dataset bundles; compares products; and verifies asset ids. The GeoAI method layer routes remote-sensing tasks such as detection, segmentation, change detection, regression, SAM, embeddings, vision-language models, and QGIS GeoAI to the smallest relevant chapter while keeping GEE/export orchestration explicit. A dedicated multimodal vectorization skill turns local or GEE imagery annotations into CRS-aware GeoPackage and GeoJSON outputs with optional tiling and overlap deduplication. Its persistent Map Console supports configurable XYZ, TMS, ArcGIS, WMS, WMTS, raster PMTiles, and COG sources; basemap overlays and layer controls; lazy high-performance rendering; and credential-safe local profiles.
